svg.title: Chip floorplan 1x0p5
svg.text: Chip floorplan: Analog_top + asic_digital_top in the wafer.space 1x0p5 pad ring (digital on top)
Die 3.932 x 2.531 mm, core 3.048 x 1.647 mm, 72 pads. Drawn to scale (0.3 px/um). Pads: gf180mcu_ocd_io, measured 75.32 x 350 um, corners 355 um.
Areas are estimates from the netlist (no analog layout exists); the digital outline is its GDS bounding box.
north: AVDD pair, bidir[43:26], 2 x DVDD/DVSS
south: clk, rst_n, bidir[0:17], 2 x DVDD/DVSS
free core: fill + density only (wafer.space slot is pad-limited)
Zoom A: analog + digital corner (0.9 px/um)

g.text: AVDD strap, 10 um, 997 um from bidir[45]
AVSS strap, 10 um, 892 um from bidir[44]
outline from its GDS; soft cells in the Chip flow

svg.text: Analog macro contents (um²; MIM over the circuit, so area = max(devices, MIM))
· devices = 3.27 x project MOS footprint (k measured on drawn UC_MIM, DRC 0)
· MIM footprint = plate + 1.91 um keep-out per side (same record)
· pad positions: evenly spaced between corners; confirm with the padmap (T2.2)
· AVDD/AVSS: dedicated straps, never through the core ring
· Metal4/Metal5 PDN keep-out over the macro: the MIMs use M4/M5
